description: Pure logic foundation (no UI): the shared derived-totals contract and all share/encode/decode/validate logic. Extract PrintLayout's section-visibility predicate and useCharacter's inline derivations into reusable pure modules; add the view-route helpers, base64url + gzip codecs, the versioned share-codec envelope, the untrusted-payload validator, the link portrait/log trim + length thresholds, and the plain-text combat stat block generator. This is the AC2 'reuse, don't fork' foundation that FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on. Independent of FEAT-002/003 but must land first (they import these modules).
steps: Create src/logic/section-visibility.ts exporting the SectionKey union (spells|companions|mutations|criticalWounds|hirelings|enterprises|grudgeBook|psychologyTraits|rituals|yenlui|estate|conditions|ammunition) and shouldRenderSection(character, key) copied VERBATIM from src/components/layout/PrintLayout.tsx; then edit PrintLayout.tsx to delete its module-private copy and import the identical function (import-only change, no behavior change).

Create src/logic/sheet-totals.ts exporting interface SheetTotals and deriveSheetTotals(character): lift verbatim from useCharacter — hardyLevel (Hardy talent lvl), strongBackLevel/sturdyLevel (talents), woundMultiplier (SPECIES_DATA[species]?.woundMultiplier ?? 1), effectiveWoundsUseSB (species.woundsUseSB when species known else stored woundsUseSB), SB=getBonus(S total), rangedDamageSBMode; totals wounds=computeWoundMaximum(S,T,WP,hardyLevel,effectiveWoundsUseSB,woundMultiplier), armourPoints=apResultToArmourPoints(calculateArmourPointsUnified(armour,{filterByWorn:true})) re-keyed APResult->sheet ArmourPoints (head/lArm/rArm/body/lLeg/rLeg/shield, identical to useCharacter's memo), maxEncumbrance=calculateMaxEncumbrance(chars,strongBackLevel,sturdyLevel), coinWeight=calculateCoinWeight(wGC,wSS,wD). Pure; no React/DOM/storage. Cite Core pages in comments.

Refactor src/hooks/useCharacter.ts to source its returned totalWounds/armourPoints/maxEncumbrance/coinWeight memos from deriveSheetTotals(character). Leave ALL side-effecting sync effects (syncWoundFields, auto-wCur, talent/armour/Fatigued syncs) untouched. Observable behavior must be identical so existing useCharacter tests stay green.

Create src/logic/view-route.ts: VIEW_ROUTE_PREFIX='view'; parseViewRoute(hash) returns the opaque payload after 'view/' or null (NO decoding/validation); formatViewHref(origin, pathname, encoded) returns `${origin}${pathname}#view/${encoded}`.

Create src/logic/base64url.ts (base64urlEncode/base64urlDecode via btoa/atob; reject chars outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] before decoding; no structuredClone) and src/logic/gzip.ts (gzip(bytes)/gunzip(bytes,maxBytes) over CompressionStream/DecompressionStream; gunzip aborts once summed chunk length exceeds maxBytes).

Create src/logic/share-codec.ts: SHARE_FORMAT_V=1; encodeSharePayload(json:string):Promise<string> = base64url([SHARE_FORMAT_V]++gzip(utf8(json))); decodeSharePayload(encoded):Promise<{ok:true;json}|{ok:false;error;code}> with order reject>MAX_ENCODED_CHARS, base64url decode, version-byte check, gunzip(...,MAX_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES), UTF-8 decode {fatal:true}. Define size constants MAX_ENCODED_CHARS=2_000_000, MAX_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES=4_000_000, MAX_JSON_CHARS=3_000_000 (here or in share-portrait.ts, imported by both).

Create src/logic/share-validate.ts: validateSharedPayload(json):{ok:true;character}|{ok:false;error}. Order: (1) version pre-check — JSON.parse in try/catch, reject unless raw _v is a finite number <= CURRENT_VERSION (catches non-numeric _v importFromJSON would relabel); (2) delegate to importFromJSON; (3) normalize in place via a single-sourced spec: export ARRAY_FIELDS=['weapons','armour','bSkills','aSkills','talents','trappings','conditions','spells','ammo','mutations','diseases'] each Array.isArray(x)?x:[]; coerce chars[k].{i,a,b} and move.{m,w,r} non-finite->0; non-object houseRules->BLANK_CHARACTER.houseRules and validate rangedDamageSBMode in none|halfSB|fullSB + ignoreBackpackEnc boolean; non-string species->''; each armour[].worn=item.worn!==false; scalar numerics (wCur,corr,sin,fate,fortune,wGC,wSS,wD) non-finite->0; portrait kept only if isValidPortraitDataUrl else ''. No storage writes.

Create src/logic/share-portrait.ts: SHARE_SOFT_LIMIT=8000, SHARE_HARD_LIMIT=16000; trimForLink(character) returns character with portrait:'' and eventLog:[] (snapshot keeps both); a classifier mapping a full href length via >= into none/soft/hard.

Create src/logic/combat-stat-block.ts: buildCombatStatBlock(character):string calling deriveSheetTotals(character) once. Emit name/species/careerLevel; combat chars line WS BS S T I Ag Dex (i+a+b); Wounds:<t.wounds.total>; Move/Walk/Run from stored move.{m,w,r} (Core p.164 comment); Armour: from t.armourPoints (worn-only, Core p.293); one line per weapon with reach/range and damage via calcWeaponDamage(w,t.SB,character.talents,w.runes??[],t.rangedDamageSBMode) — when num===null print the raw damage string never null; qualities; active conditions (level>0). Do NOT list ammunition. Plain text only.

Add tests: src/logic/__tests__/sheet-totals.test.ts (deriveSheetTotals deep-equals useCharacter's totalWounds/armourPoints(toEqual)/maxEncumbrance/coinWeight for fixtures incl. Ogre, Hardy+StrongBack+Sturdy, unworn + worn===undefined armour, non-default rangedDamageSBMode ranged weapon); src/logic/__tests__/view-route.test.ts; src/logic/__tests__/gzip.test.ts (OPENS with expect(typeof CompressionStream).toBe('function') and DecompressionStream, then round-trip + maxBytes abort); src/logic/__tests__/share-codec.property.test.ts (fast-check round-trip over JSON strings + serialized Character arbitraries, base64url round-trip over Uint8Array, malformed/truncated/wrong-first-byte never throw, oversized reject, validateSharedPayload rejects missing-key/non-object/_v>CURRENT_VERSION/_v:'abc'/_v:null with version message and accepts a real export); src/logic/__tests__/share-validate.hardening.test.ts (enumerate exported ARRAY_FIELDS + scalar/object spec wrong-typed, assert ok:true + coercions + deriveSheetTotals(result) does not throw); src/logic/__tests__/combat-stat-block.test.ts; src/logic/__tests__/share-portrait.test.ts (link strips portrait+eventLog, snapshot keeps them, thresholds on full href from formatViewHref with >=).
acceptance_criteria: deriveSheetTotals(fixture) wounds.total, armourPoints (deep-equal in sheet key vocabulary), maxEncumbrance, and coinWeight equal useCharacter's returned values for every fixture (Ogre, Hardy/StrongBack/Sturdy, unworn+undefined armour, non-default rangedDamageSBMode) — AC2.
PrintLayout imports shouldRenderSection from src/logic/section-visibility.ts and its existing tests pass unchanged.
decodeSharePayload(await encodeSharePayload(json)) returns {ok:true,json} byte-equal for arbitrary inputs; malformed/oversized inputs return {ok:false} and never throw.

validateSharedPayload rejects missing-required-key, non-object, _v>CURRENT_VERSION, and non-numeric _v (string/null) with the version message; accepts a real exported character; coerces every wrong-typed field in the single-sourced spec so deriveSheetTotals does not throw.

buildCombatStatBlock emits name, combat characteristics, wounds, movement, worn-only armour by location, weapons with calcWeaponDamage-derived damage (raw string when num===null), and active conditions; no ammunition; numbers equal deriveSheetTotals'.
trimForLink strips portrait and eventLog for the link while the snapshot retains them; the length classifier uses >= on the full href.
verification: vitest --run src/logic  (all new logic tests pass; existing useCharacter and PrintLayout tests still green)
npx eslint .  (0 errors, no new warnings)
findings:
Foundation modules landed in src/logic/ for FEAT-002/003 to import:

- section-visibility.ts: exports `SectionKey` union + `shouldRenderSection(character, key)` (verbatim copy from PrintLayout, which now imports it). The GM viewer should import this to decide which optional sections to render.
- sheet-totals.ts: exports `interface SheetTotals` + `deriveSheetTotals(character)`. This is the AC2 reuse contract — the viewer and stat block MUST call this (do not recompute). It returns { hardyLevel, strongBackLevel, sturdyLevel, woundMultiplier, effectiveWoundsUseSB, SB, rangedDamageSBMode, wounds (full computeWoundMaximum breakdown with .total/.sb/.tb/.wpb/.hardy for tooltips), armourPoints (sheet ArmourPoints vocab: head/lArm/rArm/body/lLeg/rLeg/shield), maxEncumbrance, coinWeight }. useCharacter now sources its returned armourPoints/maxEncumbrance/coinWeight from this and totalWounds via calculateTotalWounds(chars, totals.effectiveWoundsUseSB, hardyLevel, woundMultiplier) to preserve its historical Math.max(0,...) floor; computeWoundMaximum does NOT floor, so if the viewer needs a floored wounds total use Math.max(0, wounds.total).
- view-route.ts: VIEW_ROUTE_PREFIX='view'; parseViewRoute(hash) returns the opaque payload after 'view/' (or null) with NO decode/validate; formatViewHref(origin, pathname, encoded). AppContent must intercept parseViewRoute BEFORE the welcome/shell branch, and App() before startup migration (per context.json). A useViewRoute.ts hook still needs creating in a later feature.
- base64url.ts: base64urlEncode(Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>)/base64urlDecode(string). Decode throws on chars outside [A-Za-z0-9_-]; callers should wrap in try/catch (share-codec already does).
- gzip.ts: gzip(bytes)/gunzip(bytes, maxBytes) over CompressionStream/DecompressionStream. These are Node>=20 globals, NOT in jsdom — app-side MUST feature-detect `typeof CompressionStream === 'undefined'` to disable the share-LINK action (the snapshot/file path does not need gzip). Params are typed Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> due to the aliased TS7 lib's stricter ArrayBufferLike vs ArrayBuffer; pass `new TextEncoder().encode(...)`, `new Uint8Array(n)`, or `.slice()` results (NOT `.subarray()`, which keeps ArrayBufferLike).
- share-codec.ts: SHARE_FORMAT_V=1; encodeSharePayload(json):Promise<string>; decodeSharePayload(encoded):Promise<{ok:true;json}|{ok:false;error;code}> (codes: too-large|bad-base64url|empty|bad-version|bad-gzip|bad-utf8). Exports size constants MAX_ENCODED_CHARS=2_000_000, MAX_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES=4_000_000, MAX_JSON_CHARS=3_000_000 (import these; do not redefine).
- share-validate.ts: validateSharedPayload(json):{ok:true;character}|{ok:false;error}; exports CURRENT_VERSION=8 (mirrors export-import's private const / Character._v) and ARRAY_FIELDS. IMPORTANT: it pre-coerces ARRAY_FIELDS on the RAW parsed object before delegating to importFromJSON, because importFromJSON's armour-migration step throws on a non-array `armour` (e.g. a string). Normalizes chars triples / move / houseRules(rangedDamageSBMode+ignoreBackpackEnc) / species / armour.worn / scalar numerics / portrait so deriveSheetTotals never throws on hostile input. No storage writes. The decode+validate pipeline for the viewer is: decodeSharePayload -> (ok) validateSharedPayload(json) -> deriveSheetTotals.
- share-portrait.ts: SHARE_SOFT_LIMIT=8000, SHARE_HARD_LIMIT=16000; trimForLink(character) returns a copy with portrait:'' and eventLog:[] (use for the LINK; the file/clipboard SNAPSHOT keeps both); classifyLinkLength(hrefLength) -> 'none'|'soft'|'hard' using >= on the FULL href from formatViewHref.
- combat-stat-block.ts: buildCombatStatBlock(character):string (plain text; calls deriveSheetTotals once; weapon damage via calcWeaponDamage(w, t.SB, character.talents, w.runes??[], t.rangedDamageSBMode) printing the raw damage string when num===null; no ammunition).

Calculated-total tooltips (steering): the viewer must show breakdown tooltips for every displayed total using Tooltip.tsx + TooltipTriggerCell.tsx and the existing *BreakdownContent components (src/components/pages/); sheet-totals exposes wounds.{sb,tb,wpb,hardy} to feed the wounds breakdown. The sanctioned `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` pattern (mirroring Tooltip.tsx) was NOT needed in FEAT-001.

Verification run from d:\Git\PWACharSheet, all clean: `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit` (0 errors); `vitest --run` full suite 5267 passed / 479 files, 0 failed, no unhandled errors; `npm run build` built in 704ms; `npx eslint .` 0 errors, 3 warnings (all pre-existing react-refresh/only-export-components in CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx — untouched by this feature).
